title: Why It Is Important To Discover Your Purpose
paragraphs: Your greatest discovery in life really is discovering your personal purpose. Because purpose distinguishes you from everybody else. If you don't know your purpose in life, that means you're clear picture in life, then life has no true meaning for you. As a matter of fact, without purpose, you experiment with life. If you don't know why you were born, then you do many different things. You actually hold a million different jobs. You're always changing jobs every year or every month.

You keep kind of boxingyourself around and and you and you you go back to school 20 times to take 20different degrees. You are confused. Wasting time, wasting money, wastingenergy, wasting talent, and then wasting relationships. Purpose protects you from experimentation. Also, purposemakes your life precise. You know, uh if you know you're going tothe airport, you know what roads won't take you there, right? You can be very precise if you know your destination. So, precision comes from purpose.

If you knew exactly why you were born, what you were born to do, tapping into that, you begin to appreciate that youdon't have to be distracted by so many other things. It keeps you with a precision. Without purpose, you only exist. You wake up in the morning, go through the same routine stuff, go to the same place that you call a job.

You work for people you don't like, get paid less than you're worth, and they keep you there for 5 40 years, give you a rocking chair at the end ofthe clock and tell you go home, and then live the rest of your life out onpension. This is about what most people's livesare like. You just exist. You should never go to your job without a clear purpose for being there. Because purpose will determine whether your job is temporary or permanent. Do you understand what I'm saying?

If you In other words, I I had many jobs inmy life. I used to work for many different companies. I used to work in awarehouse. I used to work for a food store, stocking the shelf. I used towork for a advertising agency, you know, producing ads for the newspaper. I usedto work in a in a lumber company, you know, driving a forklift. I workedall kind of jobs, but I always knew this is not my permanent residence. Your purpose protects you from hating your job. Because you know that your job is not your permanentplace.
